messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — spotted a latency bump in the canary rollout (172-canary) after the kernel update. anyone else seeing this?
Maria (VP Eng): Saw the alert. can you paste the metric snapshot? p50/p95/p99?
Sam: p50 ~ 42ms (was ~35ms), p95 180ms (was 120ms), p99 420ms (was 310ms). KV cache hit dropped too: 92% -> 55%.
Jordan (Infra): Deploy-bot shows the canary used fused-attn-v2 kernels + new batching scheduler at 09:12 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deploy 172-canary applied by @ravi at 2025-03-10T09:12:18Z. Jobs: kernel-upgrade, scheduler-tweak. :rocket:
Ravi (Runtime): I pushed a fallback path for int8 kernels to handle certain shapes. suspected cause: small-sequence workloads hitting fallback path that forces extra memcpy.
Akiko (SRE): Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/boards/latency?canary=172 — seeing a spike aligned with the deploy window. error rate steady, so correctness OK.
Lee (Product): Any customer-facing impact? which customers hit the small-seq path?
Sam: Mostly short-chat workloads (<=64 tokens) — internal staging and a few beta customers. not widespread yet.
Maria (VP Eng): Action items: 1) confirm root cause 2) rollback if we can't get a quick fix 3) add regression test. who owns?
Ravi (Runtime): I'll profile today. initial flamegraphs show extra memcpy around kv-cache deserialize in fused-attn fallback. suspect kernel-selection bug that avoids prepacked weights.
Jordan (Infra): I'll prepare a safe rollback plan for the kernel change and a capacity check for canary rollback.
Akiko (SRE): I'll create a transient alert to catch KV hit-rate drops (threshold 75%) and a p99 latency alert (threshold 350ms). linking incident: INC-2345
Sam: Quick repro command I used: ```python
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-transformer-1", input="hi"*10, max_tokens=20)
print(resp.latency_ms)
```
Ravi (Runtime): Reproduced locally. patch idea: force kernel-selection to prefer prepacked path for seq<=64 until we fix fallback path. will open PR.
Maria (VP Eng): Good. set a 2-hour SLA to either fix or rollback. escalate if we miss.
Lee (Product): Please ping me when we decide rollback — I'll notify beta customers if needed.
Ravi (Runtime): PR #4092 opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4092 — experimental flag `runtime.kernel_safe_mode=true` to force old kernel selection.
Jordan (Infra): Testing the rollback now in canary, will report within 20m.
Akiko (SRE): Noted. I've muted the noisy alert while we triage and added a postmortem template.
Sam: thanks — I added a short prompt set to the regression suite (small-seq latency) and created ticket QA-678 for automated runs on PRs.
Maria (VP Eng): Appreciate the rapid triage. please record the exact perf numbers pre/post and include CPU/GPU memcopies in the postmortem.
Ravi (Runtime): Will do. provisional ETA for fix: 3-4 hours. fallback plan = rollback kernel in canary, then gradual rollback to stable.
Jordan (Infra): Canary rollback complete at 09:56 UTC. preliminary numbers: p95 back to 125ms, p99 315ms, KV hit 89%.
Sam: Confirmed on staging loadgen. looks much better. :thumbsup:
Lee (Product): Thanks team. keep me updated on postmortem and customer comms.
Maria (VP Eng): Closing loop: add a regression that runs quantized and int8 kernels on small sequences in CI. assign to Ravi + QA.
Sam: I'll follow up in #eng-runtime with the lightweight perf logs.
Akiko (SRE): Filing postmortem draft: PM-TRIAGE-1827502461. assign initial author @ravi.
Ravi (Runtime): I'll own the postmortem. thanks everyone.
Maria (VP Eng): Great work moving fast. we'll cover this in next all-hands follow-up notes.
